finalText:
**Found it.** Every failing case had a percent coupon.

`engine.js` rounded the running USD total to cents after each discount. Then it rounded again after converting to the order currency. That is two roundings, and the leftover fraction got multiplied by the exchange rate first.

Most carts look fine because the leftover only sometimes crosses a rounding line. It showed up on GBP, CAD and JPY, never on USD or EUR.

The fix keeps full precision through the discounts and rounds once at the end, in the target currency's own decimal places.

40 pass, 0 fail, 0.08s. Same result three runs, so it was never flaky.

One thing I left alone: a flat coupon larger than the cart still returns a negative total.
